{{Top|leg}}
A '''medical datapad''' was a small device used for the analysis and detection of diseases before they could act on the body of the infected [[Sentience/Legends|beings]]. They were used [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy-wide]] in most of the galactic [[Medcenter/Legends|hospitals]], including the [[Mah Dala Infirmary]].
